fusions.name: Sewn Lips
fusions.desc: Spits a knotted thread that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Marginal Gloss
fusions.desc: Annotates an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 9 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at full reach. It needs an affliction of yours on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Redlined Draft
fusions.desc: Strikes out 1 condition on you and on every ally.

fusions.name: Annotated Robe
fusions.desc: Conjures a robe stitched with spell marks: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 6% and your mana regeneration by 15%.
